class.name: Bullet
class.brief_description: Bullet detects overlaps in its Area3D.
class.description: Bullet is an Area3D that calls hit logic on the overlapping hittable_script if a [CollisionObject3D] with metadata [param hittable] = [code]true[/code] overlaps it.

method.name: body_entered_area
method.description: Called if a body is overlapping the Area3D. Checks if the body has metadata [param hittable] = [code]true[/code], and if so, it calls [code]_on_hit[/code] Also reduces [param damage] and sets [param hit] = true

method.name: _ready
method.description: Connects [signal body_entered] to [method body_entered_area] Disables gravity for [param RigidBody].

method.name: _physics_process
method.description: Applies movement force to [param RigidBody] based on Bullet Speed. Checks if [param Lifetime] is 0 and calls [code]get_parent()->queue_free()[/code] if so.

method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.

members.member: Bullet maximum speed in units per second.
Bullet's inital damage. Reduced on each hit by [method body_entered_area].
Reference to the bullet [RigidBody3D], typically the root node of the PackedScene.
Bullet lifetime before deleting its parent in seconds.
